test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 31 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The erroneously spelt word is '**Solusion**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Among the given Options the incorrectly spelt word is '**Solusion**'. • Its correct spelling is '**Solution**'. • It means 'a way of solving a problem, dealing with a difficult situation, etc.' [किसी समस्‍या, कठिनाई आदि से निपटने का ढंग; हल, समाधान] • *Example: a **solution** to the problem of unemployment...* **Correct Answer:__** *Solusion.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Trustworthy**: that you can depend on to be good, sincere, honest, etc. [विश्‍वास-योग्‍य, विश्‍वसनीय, भरोसेमंद] • **Bonafide**: real or genuine. [वास्‍तविक, प्रामाणिक, असली, सच्‍चा] • **Cultural**: connected with the customs, ideas, beliefs, etc. of a society or country. [किसी समाज या देश की प्रथाओं, विचारधाराओं, विश्‍वासों आदि से संबंधित; सांस्‍कृतिक] 47:T9c4, The correct answer is '**Contemporaries**'.
